reasoning: 1980 Parish+#3-pick for GSW #1 swap. Both teams wanted an upgrade at the pick they preferred; BOS got McHale with #3 and Parish as a bonus. Draft-night same-tier swap, neither team in distress.
1998 draft-night swap of #6 (Traylor) for #9 (Dirk) + Pat Garrity. Both picked who they preferred; classic same-tier draft-day exchange that became lopsided only because of Dirk outcome.
Kobe/Divac 1996. Charlotte was rebuilding, shipped #13 pick rights (Kobe) for veteran Vlade Divac. Picking assets over a vet from the Hornets' side is the driver.
SEA sent 1990 #1 pick (Payton) to GSW for Alton Lister; pick swap + vet role player. Neither side distressed — Seattle was adding a frontcourt piece on a pick bet that paid out massively.
Harden→HOU 2012. OKC refused to pay luxury tax on a 4th max extension. Cap-driven sale of an ascending young star; canonical teardown per signature doc.
1987 Pippen/Polynice draft-night swap. SEA took Pippen at #5 for CHI, CHI took Polynice at #8. Both teams got the player they wanted pre-arranged; picks went at the same draft.
Carmelo Anthony formally requested out of Denver for months; trade happened at Feb 2011 deadline when he would not sign an extension with DEN. Classic disgruntled-star exit.
LeBron 2010 Decision sign-and-trade. LeBron as a free agent demanded the move; CLE cooperated only to get trade compensation (cash + picks). Driver = LeBron leaving CLE.
T-Mac 2000 sign-and-trade to Orlando. McGrady signed with ORL as RFA-adjacent; TOR received compensation only because McGrady was leaving. Player-driven departure.
Feb 2012 deadline rental: NJ acquires Gerald Wallace to push for playoffs, gives up a lottery-protected pick that became Damian Lillard. Classic deadline win-now move gone wrong.
1982 Wilkins draft rights to ATL for John Drew + Freeman Williams + cash. Jazz took veteran production over unproven #3 pick; same-tier swap in the moment.
Feb 1980 deadline: LAL sent vet Don Ford + 1982 pick (became Worthy) to CLE for Butch Lee. Cleveland took a rental / vet flip; pick became lottery-winning Worthy selection.
1979 draft-pick swap #4 for #5 + cash. Both teams got the player they preferred (Moncrief vs Kelser); same-tier exchange.
1976 minor pick-swap deal. Second-round picks + vet Fred Carter exchanged. No distress on either side; picks-for-a-vet role-player swap.
2013 Gobert/Erick Green pure draft-night pick swap. Neither team under pressure; different positional preferences.
1980 POR-DEN pick-swap rights trade. Future 1983 pick became Drexler. Standard same-era pick exchange, not distressed.
1984 Cummings/Pierce/Hodges for Marques Johnson package. Two-way star swap, both teams thought they won. Same-tier vet exchange.

Paul George trade 2019. LAC contending, bought PG to pair with Kawhi (who conditioned his signing on PG). OKC's return (SGA + historic pick haul) shows contender-buys-star dynamic even as OKC kept the assets for later teardown.
Tim Hardaway Sr. to MIA 1996 for Kevin Willis + Bimbo Coles. Big-name-for-big-name vet swap, both teams trying to improve; neither distressed.
2004 draft-night pick swap between ORL and DEN; #20 rights for future lottery-protected pick. Standard pre-draft agreement.
Feb 2011 NJ wanted to shed Troy Murphy's expiring for future flexibility/pick. GSW took on Murphy, sent Brandan Wright + Dan Gadzuric + 2012 R2 (Draymond) — small salary-ballast flip.
Tatum/Fultz 2017 #1-for-#3 draft-night pick swap + future pick. Both front offices thought they won; textbook same-tier pick reshuffle that resolved lopsidedly.
Marcus Camby/McDyess 2002. NYK wanted to pair McDyess with their core; DEN added Camby + Nene. Big-vet-for-big-vet swap, both sides active.
Grant Hill 2000 sign-and-trade to ORL. Hill signed as FA with ORL; DET received compensation because Hill was leaving. Player-driven departure.
Feb 1980 Alex English to DEN for George McGinnis + pick. Big-name vet swap; IND wanted McGinnis back (previous star), DEN got younger English. Same-tier exchange.
Feb 1982 Laimbeer/Kenny Carr for Phil Hubbard/Mokeski + picks. Mid-season role-player swap with future picks attached; no distress signal.
1978 PHI/LAC World B. Free trade + future 1984 pick (Barkley). Standard role-swap with a pick attached; neither team in distress.

Kyle Lowry to TOR 2012. HOU wanted cap flexibility for Asik/Lin/their Dwight pursuit; shipped Lowry (under contract, clashing with coach) for expiring + a lottery-protected pick. Clearing money with asset attached.
CP3 to LAC Dec 2011. Paul demanded out of NOH after the league-vetoed Lakers trade. Player-driven forced exit; the Hornets (NBA-owned at time) salvaged what they could.
1979 Dantley-for-Haywood vet swap. Both teams swapping problem vets / new starts. Same-tier exchange, no clear distress.
1986 SEA-PHI future pick swap (became Kemp). PHI traded #1 future pick for vet center Clemon Johnson; role-player-for-future-pick.
Feb 1988 PHX/CLE Larry Nance blockbuster. Both teams dealing established players (Nance/Majerle pick/West vs KJ/Corbin). Star-for-star vet swap, no forced exit.
1986 CLE/DAL Mark Price draft-night rights trade. Low-stakes pick exchange — DAL passed on Price's rights for a future R2. Standard draft-night.
Webber/Penny 1993 draft-night swap + 3 future picks. Both teams got their preferred player; GSW wanted Webber, ORL wanted Penny with picks. Classic pre-arranged draft swap.
1983 Norm Nixon to LAC for Byron Scott + Swen Nater. Vet PG for young guard + center; both teams saw positional fit upgrade. Same-tier swap.
2001 draft-night pick exchange (Jefferson/Griffin + Collins). Pre-arranged pick swap, both teams took the player they targeted.
1984 Kiki Vandeweghe to POR for Lever/Natt/Cooper + picks. Big multi-player vet swap, no distress signal.
2004 Jason Terry for Antoine Walker + Delk + pick. Same-tier vet swap after Walker's uneven Dallas stint; both teams reshaping.
1996 Felton Spencer for Brooks Thompson + future pick that became Kirilenko. Routine role-player + future pick swap.
1987 Artis Gilmore return to CHI. Second-round pick for a vet center. Low-stakes role swap; Gilmore was near retirement.
Jimmy Butler sign-and-trade to MIA 2019. Heat (contender-adjacent) acquired the star; Butler signed willing — this was the destination he wanted. MIA-as-buyer is the driver.
1986 Brad Daugherty #1 pick for Roy Hinson. Both teams thought they won (PHI got a proven big, CLE got #1). Same-tier swap.
1982 Steve Hayes for a distant 1986 R2 pick (Rodman). Low-stakes vet-for-future-pick; no distress.
Feb 1994 Hornacek for Jeff Malone + pick. Two in-prime vets swap homes; both teams were active, not distressed.
1980 Jeff Ruland draft rights. Second-round pick swap, minor pre-draft deal.
2013 Brandon Jennings for Brandon Knight + Middleton + Kravtsov. Both teams trying to upgrade PG; same-tier swap.
Dwight Howard 4-team trade to LAL Aug 2012. Howard demanded out of ORL after a year-long saga (Dwightmare). Classic superstar forced exit; ORL accepted multi-team return.
1980 POR/LAL swap with Brewer + future Kersey pick. Minor role-player / future-pick trade.
2002 Stackhouse/Hamilton swap. Both teams swapping volume-scoring guards who didn't fit; same-tier vet exchange.
2004 Deng/Vroman draft-night pick swap + cash. Pre-arranged pick exchange, both got preferred player.
2006 Aldridge/Tyrus Thomas draft-night swap + R2 pick. Both teams got their target.
Eddy Curry to NYK 2005. CHI wanted out of a heart-condition contract with Curry; shipped him for Tim Thomas expiring + 4 picks (became Noah + Aldridge path). Cap/risk-clearing with asset attached.
2006 Rajon Rondo #21 pick for Brian Grant + future protected pick. Draft-night rights move; BOS was pre-KG era, PHX trading a late R1.

2007 Kurt Thomas + 2 future picks (Ibaka + Pondexter) for a R2. SEA/OKC absorbed Thomas' contract as a pick-banking play — early rebuild asset-accumulation, closer to teardown but PHX wasn't distressed either. Same-tier pick harvest.
Jan 1977 Truck Robinson/Tom Henderson vet swap + pick swap. Mid-season role-player exchange, both sides active.
Pierce/KG to BKN 2013. Boston hit reset — Rondo was on his own, ownership wanted picks for a rebuild. Canonical teardown by BOS, BKN was the win-now buyer. Driver = Boston selling.
1992 Mookie Blaylock + Roy Hinson for Rumeal Robinson. Mid-tier vet-for-vet; ATL took upside, NJ took a known guard.
1997 Bobby Jackson + James Cotton + R2 (Rashard Lewis). Low-stakes draft-night rights / pick move; no team in distress.
AD to LAL 2019. Davis formally requested via Rich Paul months prior; NOP extracted max package. Canonical forced_exit per signature doc.
1994 Steve Smith + Grant Long for Kevin Willis + future pick. Same-tier vet exchange, both active teams.
Chris Bosh to MIA 2010 sign-and-trade. Bosh chose MIA as FA to form Big 3 with LeBron/Wade; TOR got compensation only because Bosh was leaving. Player-driven departure.
Ray Allen to BOS 2007 draft night. Ainge's contender-build move (followed by KG weeks later). BOS-as-buyer, SEA in rebuild mode selling the vet.
1998 Steve Nash #15 pick to PHX for 1999 R1 (became Marion). Minor pre-draft deal; DAL hadn't seen Nash rise yet.
Feb 1979 Bob McAdoo to BOS for 1979 #3 pick (Cartwright). NYK was clearing McAdoo's big contract in a cost-motivated move; Boston paid with a high pick. Salary-plus-asset dump.
Zach Randolph to MEM 2009 for Quentin Richardson. Pure salary swap — LAC wanted out of Z-Bo's contract, MEM took a chance. Classic salary-driven with modest return.
Feb 2019 Zubac to LAC. LAL offloaded Zubac + Beasley for Muscala's expiring to open cap space for 2019 FA (AD/Kawhi pursuit). Salary/flexibility clearing.
Harden to BKN Jan 2021. Harden publicly demanded out of HOU; Rockets extracted a historic pick haul. Classic superstar forced exit per signature doc.
Jason Kidd to NJ 2001 for Marbury. Kidd requested out of PHX after off-court issues; Marbury had soured in NJ. Two forced exits rolled into one swap — dominant driver was Kidd's PHX departure.
2003 Barbosa draft rights for a future protected pick (became David Lee). Minor draft-night pick swap, low-stakes.
1978 Bobby Jones + Ralph Simpson to PHI for George McGinnis + future pick. Big-vet-for-big-vet swap, no distress. (PHI had acquired McGinnis two years earlier; this was a mutual reset.)
Shaq to MIA 2004. Shaq demanded out of LAL after the post-Finals Kobe/Shaq feud; Kupchak picked Kobe. Player-driven departure, LAL got Odom/Butler/Grant + pick as compensation.
2004 Gary Payton/Rick Fox to BOS for Chris Mihm + Chucky Atkins + future pick (Rondo). Vet swap between active rosters.
1996 Ray Allen/Marbury draft-night swap #4-for-#5 + future pick. Both teams drafted their preferred player pre-arranged.
Barkley to PHX 1992. Barkley requested a trade out of Philly; PHI got Hornacek + Lang + Perry. Player-driven exit.

Feb 2011 Mo Williams for Baron Davis + 2011 #1 pick (Kyrie). LAC wanted out of Baron Davis' remaining contract; CLE took the money + pick for a point-guard downgrade. Cap-clearing with asset attached.
1983 Billy Knight for Vince Taylor + future R1 (Vern Fleming). Minor vet-for-pick role swap.
1988 Otis Thorpe for Rodney McCray + Petersen. Same-tier frontcourt vet swap between active teams.

2004 Kenyon Martin sign-and-trade to DEN for 3 future first-rounders. Mixed signals — could be read as NJ moving on from K-Mart (salary) but pick-for-vet structure is closer to a reshuffle/FA-departure than a salary dump. Treating as reshuffle since it was a sign-and-trade for a fair contract.
2001 Elton Brand to LAC for Tyson Chandler #2 rights + Brian Skinner. CHI swapped established star for high-upside pick. Young rebuild signal but not a fire sale; closer to a reset swap.
Kevin Love to CLE Aug 2014 (Wiggins + Bennett + future pick). CLE was all-in with LeBron returned; bought a star to contend. Young-for-star contender move.
Feb 2004 Rasheed Wallace to DET (3-team). DET was a playoff team that bought Sheed as the final championship piece; won title months later. Contender-buys-star at deadline.

2001 Pau Gasol #3 pick/rights + Brevin Knight + Lorenzen Wright for Shareef Abdur-Rahim + Tinsley. Draft-night trade converting Shareef into prospects; VAN was mid-tier selling a good-but-not-great vet for upside — reshuffle rather than teardown.
1986 Sabonis pick rights swap. Draft pick exchange between non-distressed teams.
1988 Oakley/Cartwright draft-night swap + picks. Big-for-big vet exchange; both teams active trying to fit roster.
Moses Malone to PHI 1982. Reigning MVP acquired by the Sixers, who went on to win title. Classic contender buys a star.
2000 Maggette/Dooling/Strong for a package of picks ORL had accumulated. Multi-pick / multi-vet role-swap; no single distress signal.
1983 David Thirdkill + future R2 (Hornacek) for R1 and a future R2. Minor pick-swap, no distress.
1986 Dale Ellis for Al Wood. Straight vet-for-vet swap, both teams trying positional fit.
Dec 2004 Vince Carter to NJ. VC had publicly loafed in Toronto and forced the trade; TOR received Mourning (who refused to report), Eric Williams, Aaron Williams + 2 R1s. Player-driven exit.
2005 Deron Williams/Martell Webster #3-for-#6 draft-night swap + future pick. Pre-arranged swap, both took their preferred player.
1981 Vinnie Johnson for Greg Kelser. Straight vet swap, no distress signal.
Dennis Johnson to BOS 1983. BOS had just lost to 76ers in playoffs; Red Auerbach acquired DJ to pair with Bird/Parish/McHale. Contender-buys-vet-star.
2011 Kawhi draft-night rights to SAS for George Hill. IND wanted a starting PG; SAS took a chance on the #15 pick. Pre-arranged pick swap, not distressed.
1984 Dan Roundfield for Cliff Levingston + Antoine Carr + 2 R2 picks. Vet-for-youth swap; ATL liked the depth, DET wanted the established vet.
1997 Jim Jackson/Montross/Thomas/Parker for Cage/MacLean/Harris/Van Horn. Big multi-player vet/rookie swap, both active teams retooling.
1998 Chris Webber for Mitch Richmond + Otis Thorpe. Star-for-star vet swap; Webber had clashed in WAS but wasn't demanding out publicly, and Richmond was a comparable name. Same-tier exchange.
1990 Kenny Smith for John Lucas + McCormick + future pick. Mid-tier vet PG swap, both teams retooling.
Sept 1990 Kenny Smith swap (paired/duplicate of June entry; same content). Same reasoning as the June Kenny Smith trade — mid-tier vet PG swap between active teams.
2008 Jermaine O'Neal for T.J. Ford + Rasho + Hibbert. Big vet-for-package swap; IND was shedding an aging star for youth + pick, but not in full teardown — closer to a reset.
1980 Vandeweghe/Blackman draft pick swap. Future R1s exchanged both ways; standard pre-draft arrangement.
